first-christmas-stocking.title: First Christmas Fir and Star Stocking
first-christmas-stocking.engineering_note: Brief techniques named stranded colourwork and a turned heel. Per-stitch colour is not expressible in the CIR, so the firs and stars are a dc relief, one colour per round; the heel is an afterthought heel worked into a chain-bridged opening.
